description: This script creates a partition image by prepending a structured header to an input file. The header includes partition name, size, version, and root filesystem version, and the script writes the header and the original file content into a new output file.

methods.name: create_header(args, size)
methods.description: Creates a header with partition metadata packed into a binary structure using struct.pack.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads input file, creates header, and writes header plus input content into output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, sets defaults, and invokes create_output.
